policies.text: VIP passenger lounge access is granted to any frequent traveller maintaining a yearly flight count of at least 40 segments.

Authorization for executive transit is granted to any charter operator that maintains a safety rating of 95 percent or higher, a fleet size of at least 10 aircraft, indemnity protection of no less than 40,000,000 dollars, and a valid Part 135 certificate, or holds active IOSA certification.
Special charter permit validation requires an international transport firm to retain cargo insurance of at least 15 million euros.
Deep-water luxury voyage authorization is granted to cruise lines holding a Maritime Safety Code certificate.
An operator is chosen for rapid priority dispatch provided it possesses executive transit authorization and maintains a response time of no more than 3 hours.
Priority regional rail endorsement is granted to any train operator that maintains a punctual arrival rate of at least 90 percent across regional routes.
